nodes.label: cmd/crio/main.go
nodes.desc: main() at L165 wires the urfave/cli app, then calls server.New (L402) and registers RuntimeServiceServer + ImageServiceServer on one gRPC listener (L462-463).

nodes.label: pkg/config Config
nodes.desc: Config struct (L119) is the single TOML config root; DefaultConfig at L1154, Validate at L1276.

nodes.label: server.Server
nodes.desc: Server (L69) implements both CRI services; New (L436) assembles runtime, storage, streaming, metrics and NRI.

nodes.label: lib.ContainerServer
nodes.desc: ContainerServer (L48) owns sandbox/container stores, ID indexes, and hands out StorageImageServer (L140) and StorageRuntimeServer (L164).

nodes.label: RunPodSandbox
nodes.desc: RunPodSandbox (L69) is the CRI pod entrypoint; the linux path in sandbox_run_linux.go creates storage, namespaces, network and the infra container.

nodes.label: CreateContainer
nodes.desc: CreateContainer (L429) builds the OCI spec: mounts (L1256), env, user, devices, then persists the container in storage.

nodes.label: PullImage
nodes.desc: PullImage (L32) deduplicates concurrent pulls via pullOperationsInProgress and delegates to the containers/image based service.

nodes.label: storage runtimeService
nodes.desc: runtimeService.CreatePodSandbox (L358) and CreateContainer (L443) wrap containers/storage snapshots: layers, mount labels, metadata.

nodes.label: storage imageService
nodes.desc: imageService.PullImage (L958) copies layers via containers/image into the local containers/storage store.

nodes.label: oci.Runtime dispatch
nodes.desc: Runtime (L47) plus the RuntimeImpl interface (L60); RuntimeImpl() (L321) selects the implementation per runtime handler.

nodes.label: runtimeOCI (conmon)
nodes.desc: Host-process implementation: conmon supervises runc; CreateContainer (L120), StartContainer (L402), StopContainer (L985).

nodes.label: runtimeVM (shim v2)
nodes.desc: Shim v2 implementation for VM runtimes (Kata, gVisor): CreateContainer (L167), startRuntimeDaemon (L331), ParseShimAddress (L305).
